Name: WaterDrivenInfrastructure
Author: Jared
Description: Adds water-powered sawmills, forges, grinding and stamp mills, ore sluices, fishponds, fish funnels and mill race outlets. Build a water wheel on a river, then run your machines from it. A Mill Race Outlet gives unclean water at any outdoor location. Craft a Mill Race, build the outlet anywhere outside, and draw water freely. It freezes in winter, but a lit fire, or a hot Water-Driven Forge or Workshop, keeps the stations at that location running. A running outlet also fills a Rain Cistern there with river water for the winter. Feed your fishpond, plant reed and cattail beds where the race brings water, build a Water Basin for Sanctuary, and fit an Overshot Wheel to speed up a sawmill, grinding mill, workshop or ore sluice. A water-driven stamp mill crushes greenstone and bog iron a hopper at a time. Building and working the stations trains Smithing, Crafting, Woodworking, Herbalism and Fishing. Needs only CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later. Every recipe uses the framework's shared Metal Nail, Tin Solder and Metal Sheet, and WDI's own old rivets, solder and cast sheets turn into those by themselves in an existing save. Advanced Copper Tools is optional. Tested with EA 0.68b.
